sentences.text: Jimmy Donal `` Jimbo '' Wales -LRB- -LSB- 'd ʒɪmi_ˈdoʊnəl_ˈweɪlz -RSB- born August 7 , 1966 in Huntsville , Alabama -RRB- is an American Internet entrepreneur .	Huntsville	Huntsville, Alabama	Alabama	Alabama	Internet entrepreneur	list of Internet entrepreneurs	American	Americans
He is the co-founder of Wikipedia , the online non-profit encyclopedia , and the for-profit web hosting company Wikia .	Wikipedia	Wikipedia	encyclopedia	encyclopedia	Wikia	Wikia
Wales was born in Huntsville , Alabama , where he attended Randolph School , a university-preparatory school .	Huntsville	Huntsville, Alabama	Alabama	Alabama	Randolph School	Randolph School

Later , he earned bachelor 's and master 's degrees in Finance from Auburn University and the University of Alabama , respectively .	Alabama	Alabama	Auburn University	Auburn University	Finance	Finance	University of Alabama	University of Alabama

While in graduate school , Wales taught at two universities ; however , he departed before completing a PhD to take a job in finance , and later worked as the Research Director of a Chicago , Illinois , futures and options firm .	PhD	Doctor of Philosophy
In 1996 , he and two partners founded Bomis , an adult web portal featuring entertainment and adult content .	Bomis	Bomis

The company would provide the initial funding for the peer-reviewed free encyclopedia , Nupedia -LRB- 2000 -- 03 -RRB- , and its successor , Wikipedia .	Wikipedia	Wikipedia	encyclopedia	encyclopedia	Nupedia	Nupedia

On January 15 , 2001 , with Larry Sanger and others , Wales launched Wikipedia -- a free , open content encyclopedia that enjoyed rapid growth and popularity ; as Wikipedia 's public profile grew , he became the project 's promoter and spokesman .
